evidence.reviewer_note: Source wording checked against official NASA page by assistant Oct 22; personal human review NOT established.

evidence.reviewer_note: Official IAU page supersedes inaccessible legacy PDF; source cross-checked by assistant, not by owner.

evidence.title: How much water is in the ocean?
